definitions.explanation: Indicates that something stands out to a notable degree, or that there is nothing particularly noteworthy. Very commonly used with negatives to mean 'nothing in particular' or 'not especially.'

examples.japanese: {特段|とくだん}⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Nothing particularly unusual is going on.

examples.japanese: {特段|とくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{参加|さんか}して→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please participate unless you have a particular reason not to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{特段|とくだん}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}られなかった→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、ご⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: No particular problems were found in this examination, so please rest assured.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as an adverb ({特段|とくだん}) or as a noun modifier ({特段|とくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧). Very frequently used with negative expressions to mean "nothing in particular" or "not especially." It has a somewhat formal tone and is common in business, official, and written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特段|とくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no particular problems)
- {特段|とくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧ (particular reason)
- {特段|とくだん}{変|か}わり⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (nothing particularly different)
- {特段|とくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支障|ししょう}→支障：12934_shishou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no particular hindrance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧: especially, particularly (more common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧: exceptional, special (emphasizes standing out positively)
- {別段|べつだん}: (not) particularly (similar usage with negatives, slightly more literary)
